+"""MLIR core IR data structures."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any, Callable
+from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
+from enum import Enum, auto
+
+
+class MLIRContext:
+    """Global context for MLIR objects."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._registered_dialects: Dict[str, Dialect] = {}
+        self._type_cache: Dict[str, Type] = {}
+
+    def register_dialect(self, dialect: Dialect) -> None:
+        self._registered_dialects[dialect.name] = dialect
+
+    def get_dialect(self, name: str) -> Optional[Dialect]:
+        return self._registered_dialects.get(name)
+
+    def get_or_create_type(self, key: str, factory: Callable) -> Type:
+        if key not in self._type_cache:
+            self._type_cache[key] = factory()
+        return self._type_cache[key]
+
+
+class Dialect:
+    """Base class for MLIR dialects."""
+
+    def __init__(self, name: str, context: MLIRContext) -> None:
+        self.name = name
+        self.context = context
+        self._operations: Dict[str, type] = {}
+        context.register_dialect(self)
+
+    def register_operation(self, op_class: type) -> None:
+        self._operations[op_class.operation_name()] = op_class
+
+    def get_operation(self, name: str) -> Optional[type]:
+        return self._operations.get(name)
+
+
+class Type(ABC):
+    """Base class for all MLIR types."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def __str__(self) -> str:
+        pass
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
+        pass
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        pass
+
+
+class IntegerType(Type):
+    """Fixed-width integer type."""
+
+    class SignednessSemantics(Enum):
+        SIGNLESS = auto()
+        SIGNED = auto()
+        UNSIGNED = auto()
+
+    def __init__(self, width: int, signedness: SignednessSemantics = SignednessSemantics.SIGNLESS) -> None:
+        self._width = width
+        self._signedness = signedness
+
+    @property
+    def width(self) -> int:
+        return self._width
+

+"""Dataflow graph synthesis with token-based execution model."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Set, Tuple
+from enum import Enum
+
+
+class NodeType(Enum):
+    OPERATOR = "operator"
+    FORK = "fork"
+    JOIN = "join"
+    MERGE = "merge"
+    BRANCH = "branch"
+    BUFFER = "buffer"
+    SOURCE = "source"
+    SINK = "sink"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DataflowEdge:
+    """Edge in a dataflow graph carrying tokens between nodes."""
+    source: str
+    source_port: int
+    target: str
+    target_port: int
+    data_width: int = 32
+    has_token: bool = False
+    token_value: int = 0
+    buffer_slots: int = 0
+
+    def transfer_token(self, value: int) -> None:
+        mask = (1 << self.data_width) - 1
+        self.token_value = value & mask
+        self.has_token = True
+
+    def consume_token(self) -> Optional[int]:
+        if not self.has_token:
+            return None
+        value = self.token_value
+        self.has_token = False
+        self.token_value = 0
+        return value
+
+    def is_buffered(self) -> bool:
+        return self.buffer_slots > 0
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DataflowNode:
+    """Node in a dataflow graph with token-based execution."""
+    name: str
+    node_type: NodeType = NodeType.OPERATOR
+    latency: int = 1
+    num_inputs: int = 1
+    num_outputs: int = 1
+    operation: str = "nop"
+    fired_count: int = 0
+
+    def can_fire(self, input_tokens: List[bool]) -> bool:
+        if self.node_type == NodeType.MERGE:
+            return any(input_tokens)
+        elif self.node_type == NodeType.JOIN:
+            return all(input_tokens)
+        elif self.node_type == NodeType.FORK:
+            return len(input_tokens) > 0 and input_tokens[0]
+        elif self.node_type == NodeType.BRANCH:
+            return len(input_tokens) >= 2 and input_tokens[0] and input_tokens[1]
+        elif self.node_type == NodeType.SOURCE:
+            return True
+        elif self.node_type == NodeType.SINK:
+            return any(input_tokens)
+        return all(input_tokens[:self.num_inputs])
+
+    def fire(self, input_values: List[int]) -> List[int]:
+        self.fired_count += 1
+        if self.node_type == NodeType.FORK:
+            val = input_values[0] if input_values else 0
+            return [val] * self.num_outputs
+        elif self.node_type == NodeType.MERGE:
+            for v in input_values:
+                if v is not None:
+                    return [v]
+            return [0]
+        elif self.node_type == NodeType.JOIN:
+            return [input_values[0]] if input_values else [0]
+        elif self.node_type == NodeType.BRANCH:
+            condition = input_values[1] if len(input_values) > 1 else 0
+            data = input_values[0] if input_values else 0
+            if condition:
+                return [data, 0]
+            return [0, data]
+        elif self.node_type == NodeType.OPERATOR:
+            if self.operation == "add" and len(input_values) >= 2:
+                return [input_values[0] + input_values[1]]
+            elif self.operation == "mul" and len(input_values) >= 2:
+                return [input_values[0] * input_values[1]]
+            elif self.operation == "sub" and len(input_values) >= 2:
+                return [input_values[0] - input_values[1]]
+            return [input_values[0]] if input_values else [0]
+        return [0]
+
+    def throughput_contribution(self) -> float:
+        if self.latency == 0:
+            return float('inf')
+        return 1.0 / self.latency
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DataflowGraph:
+    """Complete dataflow graph with execution simulation."""
+    name: str
+    nodes: Dict[str, DataflowNode] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    edges: List[DataflowEdge] = field(default_factory=list)
+    cycle_count: int = 0
+    tokens_produced: int = 0
+    tokens_consumed: int = 0
+
+    def add_node(self, node: DataflowNode) -> None:
+        self.nodes[node.name] = node
+
+    def add_edge(self, source: str, source_port: int,
+                 target: str, target_port: int, width: int = 32) -> None:
+        edge = DataflowEdge(
+            source=source, source_port=source_port,
+            target=target, target_port=target_port,
+            data_width=width,
+        )
+        self.edges.append(edge)
+
+    def get_input_edges(self, node_name: str) -> List[DataflowEdge]:
+        return [e for e in self.edges if e.target == node_name]
+
+    def get_output_edges(self, node_name: str) -> List[DataflowEdge]:
+        return [e for e in self.edges if e.source == node_name]
+
+    def step(self) -> int:
+        fired_nodes: List[str] = []
+        for name, node in self.nodes.items():
+            input_edges = self.get_input_edges(name)
+            input_tokens = [e.has_token for e in input_edges]
+            if not input_edges and node.node_type == NodeType.SOURCE:
+                input_tokens = [True]
+            if node.can_fire(input_tokens):
+                input_values = []
+                for e in input_edges:
+                    val = e.consume_token()
+                    input_values.append(val if val is not None else 0)
+                    self.tokens_consumed += 1
+                outputs = node.fire(input_values)
+                output_edges = self.get_output_edges(name)
+                for i, edge in enumerate(output_edges):
+                    if i < len(outputs):
+                        edge.transfer_token(outputs[i])
+                        self.tokens_produced += 1
+                fired_nodes.append(name)
+        self.cycle_count += 1
+        return len(fired_nodes)
+
+    def simulate(self, num_cycles: int) -> Dict[str, int]:
+        total_fired = 0
+        for _ in range(num_cycles):
+            fired = self.step()
+            total_fired += fired
+            if fired == 0:
+                break
+        return {
+            "cycles": self.cycle_count,
+            "total_fired": total_fired,
+            "tokens_produced": self.tokens_produced,
+            "tokens_consumed": self.tokens_consumed,
+        }
+
+    def throughput(self) -> float:
+        if self.cycle_count == 0:
+            return 0.0
+        return self.tokens_produced / self.cycle_count
+
+    def find_bottleneck(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        min_throughput = float('inf')
+        bottleneck: Optional[str] = None
+        for name, node in self.nodes.items():
+            if node.node_type == NodeType.OPERATOR:
+                tp = node.throughput_contribution()
+                if tp < min_throughput:
+                    min_throughput = tp
+                    bottleneck = name
+        return bottleneck
+
+    def insert_elastic_buffer(self, edge_index: int, slots: int = 1) -> None:
+        if 0 <= edge_index < len(self.edges):
+            self.edges[edge_index].buffer_slots = slots
+
+    def node_count(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.nodes)
+
+    def edge_count(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.edges)

+"""Kernel-level IR for hardware acceleration in K-CIRCT."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Any, Tuple
+from enum import Enum
+
+
+class ScheduleConstraint(Enum):
+    ASAP = "as_soon_as_possible"
+    ALAP = "as_late_as_possible"
+    FIXED = "fixed_cycle"
+    RELATIVE = "relative_offset"
+
+
+class ResourceType(Enum):
+    ALU = "alu"
+    MULTIPLIER = "multiplier"
+    MEMORY_PORT = "memory_port"
+    DSP = "dsp"
+    BRAM = "bram"
+    REGISTER = "register"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class LatencyModel:
+    """Models operation latency for scheduling."""
+    operation_latencies: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    default_latency: int = 1
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.operation_latencies:
+            self.operation_latencies = {
+                "add": 1, "sub": 1, "mul": 3, "div": 10,
+                "load": 2, "store": 1, "cmp": 1, "mux": 0,
+                "shift": 1, "and": 1, "or": 1, "xor": 1,
+            }
+
+    def get_latency(self, op_type: str) -> int:
+        return self.operation_latencies.get(op_type, self.default_latency)
+
+    def set_latency(self, op_type: str, cycles: int) -> None:
+        self.operation_latencies[op_type] = cycles
+
+    def total_latency(self, op_types: List[str]) -> int:
+        return sum(self.get_latency(op) for op in op_types)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ResourceBinding:
+    """Binds operations to physical hardware resources."""
+    bindings: Dict[str, Tuple[ResourceType, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    resource_limits: Dict[ResourceType, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.resource_limits:
+            self.resource_limits = {
+                ResourceType.ALU: 4,
+                ResourceType.MULTIPLIER: 2,
+                ResourceType.MEMORY_PORT: 2,
+                ResourceType.DSP: 8,
+                ResourceType.BRAM: 4,
+            }
+
+    def bind(self, op_name: str, resource: ResourceType, instance: int) -> bool:
+        limit = self.resource_limits.get(resource, 1)
+        if instance >= limit:
+            return False
+        self.bindings[op_name] = (resource, instance)
+        return True
+
+    def get_binding(self, op_name: str) -> Optional[Tuple[ResourceType, int]]:
+        return self.bindings.get(op_name)
+
+    def utilization(self, resource: ResourceType) -> float:
+        bound_count = sum(1 for r, _ in self.bindings.values() if r == resource)
+        limit = self.resource_limits.get(resource, 1)
+        return bound_count / limit if limit > 0 else 0.0
+
+    def is_available(self, resource: ResourceType, instance: int) -> bool:
+        for r, i in self.bindings.values():
+            if r == resource and i == instance:
+                return False
+        return instance < self.resource_limits.get(resource, 1)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class KernelOp:
+    """Top-level kernel operation for hardware acceleration."""
+    name: str
+    operations: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
+    inputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
+    outputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
+    latency_model: LatencyModel = field(default_factory=LatencyModel)
+    resource_binding: ResourceBinding = field(default_factory=ResourceBinding)
+    schedule: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def add_operation(self, name: str, op_type: str, operands: List[str], result: str) -> None:
+        self.operations.append({
+            "name": name, "op_type": op_type,
+            "operands": operands, "result": result,
+        })
+
+    def total_operations(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.operations)
+
+    def critical_path_latency(self) -> int:
+        if not self.operations:
+            return 0
+        return sum(self.latency_model.get_latency(op["op_type"]) for op in self.operations)
+
+    def estimated_cycles(self) -> int:
+        if self.schedule:
+            return max(self.schedule.values()) + 1
+        return self.critical_path_latency()
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DataflowOp:
+    """Dataflow-level operation with token-based execution."""
+    name: str
+    op_type: str
+    input_tokens: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    output_tokens: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    latency: int = 1
+    is_ready: bool = False
+
+    def check_ready(self, available_tokens: set) -> bool:
+        self.is_ready = all(t in available_tokens for t in self.input_tokens)
+        return self.is_ready
+
+    def fire(self) -> List[str]:
+        if not self.is_ready:
+            return []
+        self.is_ready = False
+        return list(self.output_tokens)
+
+    def token_count(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.input_tokens) + len(self.output_tokens)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PipelineOp:
+    """Pipeline operation with configurable initiation interval."""
+    name: str
+    stages: int = 1
+    initiation_interval: int = 1
+    operations_per_stage: List[List[str]] = field(default_factory=list)
+    is_active: bool = False
+    current_stage: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.operations_per_stage:
+            self.operations_per_stage = [[] for _ in range(self.stages)]
+
+    def assign_to_stage(self, op_name: str, stage: int) -> bool:
+        if 0 <= stage < self.stages:
+            self.operations_per_stage[stage].append(op_name)
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def advance(self) -> int:
+        self.current_stage = (self.current_stage + 1) % self.stages
+        return self.current_stage
+
+    def throughput(self) -> float:
+        if self.initiation_interval == 0:
+            return 0.0
+        return 1.0 / self.initiation_interval
+
+    def pipeline_depth(self) -> int:
+        return self.stages
+
+    def stage_operations(self, stage: int) -> List[str]:
+        if 0 <= stage < self.stages:
+            return self.operations_per_stage[stage]
+        return []
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ArrayPartitionOp:
+    """Array partitioning for parallel memory access."""
+    name: str
+    array_size: int
+    partition_type: str = "cyclic"
+    factor: int = 2
+    dimension: int = 0
+
+    def num_partitions(self) -> int:
+        if self.partition_type == "complete":
+            return self.array_size
+        return min(self.factor, self.array_size)
+
+    def partition_index(self, array_index: int) -> int:
+        if self.partition_type == "cyclic":
+            return array_index % self.factor
+        elif self.partition_type == "block":

    "sle": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    "sgt": lambda a, b: a > b,
    "sge": lambda a, b: a >= b,
    "ult": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "ule": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    "ugt": lambda a, b: a > b,
    "uge": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}

    if name == "arith.subi":

    with open(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, name)) as f:
        return f.read()


def check_sample_arith():
    module = parse(read("sample_arith.mlir"))
    names = []
    counts = {}
    module.walk(lambda op: (names.append(op.name),
                            counts.__setitem__(op.name,
                                               counts.get(op.name, 0) + 1)))
    assert names[0] == "builtin.module"
    assert counts["func.func"] == 3
    total = sum(v for k, v in counts.items()
                if k not in ("func.func", "builtin.module"))
    assert total == 19, total

    funcs = module.body.ops
    multi = funcs[1]
    assert multi.attributes["sym_name"] == "multi_block"
    region = multi.regions[0]
    assert len(region.blocks) == 4  # entry + bb1..bb3
    entry = region.blocks[0]
    assert [a.name for a in entry.args] == ["%arg0", "%arg1"]
    cond_br = entry.ops[1]
    assert cond_br.name == "cf.cond_br"
    assert [b.name for b in cond_br.successors] == ["bb1", "bb2"]
    cmpi = entry.ops[0]
    assert cmpi.attributes["predicate"] == "sgt"

    # Constant folding: 4 folds, fixpoint (chains fold completely).
    cf = ConstantFolding()
    pm = PassManager()
    pm.add_pass(cf)
    pm.run(module)
    assert cf.get_statistic("num_folded") == 4, cf.get_statistic("num_folded")
    add_consts = funcs[0].regions[0].blocks[0].ops
    returns = [op for op in add_consts if op.name == "return"]
    folded_val = returns[0].operands[0].owner.attributes["value"]
    assert folded_val == (42 + 17) * 5, folded_val
    chain = funcs[2].regions[0].blocks[0].ops
    chain_val = [op for op in chain if op.name == "return"][0] \
        .operands[0].owner.attributes["value"]
    assert chain_val == (10 + 20) * 3, chain_val

    # Round trip: print -> parse -> print is stable and equivalent.
    module2 = parse(read("sample_arith.mlir"))
    text1 = print_module(module2)
    text2 = print_module(parse(text1))
    assert text1 == text2
    counts2 = {}
    parse(text1).walk(
        lambda op: counts2.__setitem__(op.name,
                                       counts2.get(op.name, 0) + 1))
    assert counts2.get("func.func") == 3

    module = parse(read("alu.mlir"))
    hw = module.body.ops[0]
    assert hw.name == "hw.module"
    assert hw.attributes["sym_name"] == "ALU"
    ports = hw.attributes["ports"]
    assert [(p["dir"], p["name"], p["type"]) for p in ports] == [

    body = hw.regions[0].blocks[0]
    assert [a.name for a in body.args] == ["%a", "%b", "%op"]
    op_names = [op.name for op in body.ops]
    assert op_names == [

        "hw.constant", "hw.constant", "hw.constant",
        "comb.icmp", "comb.icmp", "comb.icmp",
        "comb.mux", "comb.mux", "comb.mux",
        "hw.output",
    ], op_names
    icmp = body.ops[7]
    assert icmp.attributes["predicate"] == "eq"
    assert [v.name for v in icmp.operands] == ["%op", "%c0"]
    mux = body.ops[12]
    assert [v.name for v in mux.operands] == ["%is_add", "%add_r", "%mux2"]
    # Round trip.
    assert print_module(parse(print_module(module))) == print_module(module)


def check_counter():
    module = parse(read("counter.mlir"))
    hw = module.body.ops[0]
    assert hw.name == "hw.module"
    assert hw.attributes["sym_name"] == "Counter"
    ports = hw.attributes["ports"]
    assert [(p["dir"], p["name"], p["type"]) for p in ports] == [
        ("in", "clk", "!seq.clock"), ("in", "reset", "i1"),
        ("out", "res", "i8"),

    body = hw.regions[0].blocks[0]
    clk = body.args[0]
    assert isinstance(clk.type, OpaqueType) and str(clk.type) == "!seq.clock"
    assert isinstance(body.args[1].type, IntegerType)
    op_names = [op.name for op in body.ops]
    assert op_names == ["hw.constant", "hw.constant", "seq.compreg",
                        "comb.add", "hw.output"], op_names
    compreg = body.ops[2]
    # Forward reference: %next is used by compreg but defined after it.

    assert isinstance(compreg.operands[0], OpResult)
    assert compreg.operands[0].owner is next_def
    assert isinstance(compreg.operands[1], BlockArgument)
    # Round trip.
    assert print_module(parse(print_module(module))) == print_module(module)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    check_sample_arith()
    check_alu()
    check_counter()
    print("all sanity tests passed")
